events.event: Green SM Indonesia confirmed Green SM Bike, its electric motorbike ride-hailing service, will officially stop operating on 25 November 2026 at 23:59 WIB, while its electric car services continue.
events.key_numbers: Closure 25 Nov 2026 23:59 WIB · vehicle return window 21-25 Nov, 09:00-23:00 · refunds of deposit/e-wallet/rental fees and prorated earnings paid within 7 working days · late returns void transition benefits · priority to become Green SM car driver
events.why_it_matters: Thousands of ojol drivers have until tomorrow night to hand back bikes or lose their deposit refunds.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia Tech list 23 Nov; follows 8 ojol services closing (E1014)

events.event: Telkomsel launched OCTA Token, a pay-as-you-go prepaid token pack giving access to 69 AI models from providers including OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek, without a subscription.
events.key_numbers: Rp100.000 / Rp250.000 / Rp500.000 (tax included) · 69 AI models · 500 MB data bonus valid 30 days · token balance has no expiry · bought via MyTelkomsel for Simpati and Halo
events.why_it_matters: Ordinary prepaid users can now pay for ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude-class AI with pulsa-style top-ups instead of a monthly subscription.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC, CNN, Bisnis the same day; Indosat also selling AI tokens per Bisnis

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that warung owners at a pujasera in Setiabudi, South Jakarta, are paid Rp10.000 per hour by a China-based company to film their cooking with head-mounted cameras, which a security expert says is data for training humanoid robots and may breach the PDP Law.
events.key_numbers: Rp10.000 per hour pay · head-mounted wide-angle camera + offline camera + power bank · vendor count not given · recruiter said it was AI for people with disabilities
events.why_it_matters: Footage could capture customers' faces, phone screens and OTPs, and the vendors have no written contract.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Tech items 22 Nov, still on the Tech list on 23 Nov

events.event: DJP reported it has collected Rp2.23 trillion in tax on crypto assets since the levy began in 2022, with Rp341.61 billion collected in January-October 2026.
events.key_numbers: Total Rp2,23 T (2022-Oct 2026) · 2022 Rp246,54 M · 2023 Rp220,89 M · 2024 Rp620,38 M · 2025 Rp796,74 M · Jan-Oct 2026 Rp341,61 M · total digital-economy tax Rp60,1 T · PMSE VAT Rp46,36 T
events.why_it_matters: Crypto tax take is on pace to fall below 2025 even though the user base keeps growing.

events.event: The US Justice Department moved to forfeit more than US$1 billion of crypto stolen in the October Binance hack, which Binance linked to a hacking group tied to North Korea.
events.key_numbers: Forfeiture sought about US$1,1 miliar · total theft US$6,3 miliar · US says it helped freeze/seize/return over US$2,9 miliar across cases · ADGM Courts order granted to Binance last week
events.why_it_matters: First sign of how much of the record US$6,3 miliar can actually be clawed back.

events.event: Komdigi's written statement and Katadata/Drone Emprit figures show Google removed 19,372 Indonesia-linked YouTube channels in Q3 2026 (47% of all removals that quarter), and Google admitted its bulletin lacked explanation.
events.key_numbers: Q3 2026: 19.372 channels (Jul 6.888 · Aug 10.134 · Sep 2.350) = 47% of all removed · cumulative Q4 2021-Q3 2026 per Drone Emprit: 27.516 Indonesian channels, third after China 275.030 (68%) and Russia 55.941 · Komdigi asked for written methodology, machine/human review roles, error rates, whether channels were based in Indonesia
events.why_it_matters: New context: Indonesia ranks third worldwide for removed influence-operation channels, and Komdigi wants the same tools used against judol networks.
events.spreading_evidence: detikInet terpopuler #5 (Google ungkap aturan spam YouTube), CNBC Tech 23 Nov

events.event: Anthropic (ANT) shares fell about 4.5% intraday on Monday 23 November to around US$84.87, only slightly above the US$83 IPO price, after a 9% drop on Friday following a 17% first-day gain.
events.key_numbers: US$84,87 (-4,55%) at 15:07 ET · IPO price US$83 · Thursday +17% · Friday -9% · up to 315 juta shares (about 1/3 of the offering) eligible for sale soon · fully diluted valuation about US$1,5 T, roughly 40x trailing sales · commitments about US$900 miliar over 20 years
events.why_it_matters: The IPO pop has almost fully faded within three trading days; ANT is back near the price Indonesian retail could not buy at.
events.spreading_evidence: detikInet Anthropic employees-rich story; many outlets covering ANT

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported Trump threatened very large taxes on US companies that build data centres abroad, saying the US will not allow its companies to build data centres outside the country.
events.key_numbers: No tax rate or amount given · quote at White House press conference reported by Reuters 23 Nov · Equinix and Digital Realty named as major overseas operators · US Commerce reportedly tightened AI-chip export limits to some Southeast Asian countries
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia is racing to host AI data centres, many by US firms, so a threat to tax overseas builds hits that plan directly.

events.event: DailySocial analysis found Indonesia's announced AI data-centre capacity of about 1,810 MW is more than three times current installed capacity, while named tenants are scarce.
events.key_numbers: Announced about 1.810 MW (not 2.170 MW, which double-counts Firmus 360 MW Batam) · installed national 400-580 MW · Zankore 200 MW contracted to unnamed customers (1/5 of 1 GW target), loans up to US$3,1 miliar · CoreWeave 360 MW from 2028 · Indosat AI cloud revenue US$50 juta in 9M 2026 (target US$100 juta 2026, US$300 juta 2027) · about US$50 juta per MW
events.why_it_matters: Billions are being committed to Indonesian AI data centres before most of the customers are named.

events.event: Radar Bandung, citing OJK, reported the Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (IASC) has blocked Rp825.2 billion in scam funds and returned Rp207.16 billion to victims between 22 November 2024 and 30 September 2026.
events.key_numbers: 702.342 reports · 1.372.483 suspected scam accounts verified · 702.833 accounts coordinated for blocking · Rp825,2 M blocked · Rp207,16 M returned (about 25% of blocked) · period 22 Nov 2024-30 Sep 2026
events.why_it_matters: Gives the recovery side to the Rp104 T losses figure: only about a quarter of blocked money has gone back to victims.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported Meta restricted over 5.4 million posts and accounts in India in H1 2026 after government orders, second only to Indonesia, prompting protests at Meta offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram.
events.key_numbers: 5,4 juta posts/accounts restricted in India H1 2026 vs about 70.000 in prior period · India second behind Indonesia · removal deadline cut from 36 to 3 hours in Feb 2026 · protests 20-21 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia tops Meta's government-restriction ranking, a fact that links to the Komdigi moderation debate.
